title: Fourier coefficients after centering
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\iota$ be finite sets, and let $F$ be a Fourier system on $\Omega$ with a full-support probability law, an orthonormal basis of complex-valued functions, and a distinguished index for the constant-one basis vector. For any complex-valued function $f$ and any basis index $i$, the coefficient of $f$ minus its mean is zero at the distinguished index and equals the coefficient of $f$ at every other index.
hypotheses_covered: a probability law on $\Omega$ with full support
a basis of complex-valued functions on $\Omega$
the distinguished basis vector is constant one
the basis is orthonormal for the probability-weighted complex inner product
